character: A thin grey-muzzled man of fifty-five, callused paws, a kinked tail, a brass thimble through one ear.
wardrobe: A tarred canvas smock lined with fleece, a marlinspike hanging at his hip.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a long gallery of planks and netting hung beneath a floating rock, coils of rope at his feet.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Laying a long rope along a gallery slung under a floating island, open air beneath the netting, a dark airship with black sails hanging on lines in the distance.
